#!/bin/zsh -f
# C14 TEST ADAPTATION ONLY (not a product feature): transport the fixture's isolated
# HOME/PATH/data into the command Deskmate submits to a new iTerm tab.
L=/private/tmp/deskmate-c14-claude-20261113-dvho_hu0/evidence/resume/osascript-transport.log
script=$(cat)
print -r -- "--- $(date -u +%FT%TZ) argv: $*" >> $L
if [ "$1" = "-" ] && [ $# -eq 2 ] && [[ "$2" != /dev/* ]]; then
  cmd="export HOME=/private/tmp/deskmate-c14-claude-20261113-dvho_hu0/home PATH=/private/tmp/deskmate-c14-claude-20261113-dvho_hu0/home/.local/bin:/private/tmp/deskmate-c14-claude-20261113-dvho_hu0/pathbin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin DESKMATE_DATA_DIR=/private/tmp/deskmate-c14-claude-20261113-dvho_hu0/data; unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR CODEX_HOME CLAUDECODE CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT; $2; echo \"claude exited rc=\$?\""
  print -r -- "transported: $cmd" >> $L
  print -r -- "$script" | /usr/bin/osascript - "$cmd"
else
  print -r -- "$script" | /usr/bin/osascript "$@"
fi
